import HartshorneLib.Chapter4CanonicalDivisorSheafProducer

/-!
# Sections of a chosen canonical divisor sheaf

For a selected nonzero rational differential, the associated divisor sheaf is
described by rational functions whose product with that differential is regular.
The forward direction is the local divisor bound, while the reverse direction
constructs the bounded section explicitly.  The differential remains part of
the producer data, so these statements do not assert that a representative is
canonical.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry Opposite

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]

namespace CanonicalDivisorSheafProducer

variable (P : CanonicalDivisorSheafProducer X)

/-- Build the canonical-sheaf section represented by a regular differential
multiple on a nonempty open. -/
def sectionOfRegularMultiple
    (U : X.left.Opens) (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty)
    (f : X.left.functionField)
    (hf : ∀ (x : X.left) (_hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left), x ∈ U →
      f • P.differential ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) :
    (P.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) : Type u) := by
  change divisorSections P.divisor U
  exact ⟨f, (section_mem_iff (X := X) P U hU f).mpr hf⟩

@[simp]
theorem sectionOfRegularMultiple_value
    (U : X.left.Opens) (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty)
    (f : X.left.functionField)
    (hf : ∀ (x : X.left) (_hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left), x ∈ U →
      f • P.differential ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) :
    sectionValue (X := X) P U (sectionOfRegularMultiple (X := X) P U hU f hf) = f := by
  change ((⟨f, _⟩ : divisorSections P.divisor U) : X.left.functionField) = f
  rfl

/-- Every section is recovered from its rational-function value by the regular
differential description. -/
theorem sectionOfRegularMultiple_sectionValue
    (U : X.left.Opens) (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty)
    (s : (P.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) : Type u)) :
    sectionOfRegularMultiple (X := X) P U hU (sectionValue (X := X) P U s)
      (sheaf_section_regular (X := X) P U hU s) = s := by
  apply sectionValue_injective (X := X) P U
  simp only [sectionOfRegularMultiple_value]

/-- Restricting a section represented by a regular differential multiple keeps
the same rational-function representative on every nonempty smaller open. -/
theorem sectionOfRegularMultiple_res
    {U V : X.left.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty) (hV : (V : Set X.left).Nonempty)
    (f : X.left.functionField)
    (hf : ∀ (x : X.left) (_hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left), x ∈ U →
      f • P.differential ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) :
    divisorSectionsRes P.divisor hVU
        (sectionOfRegularMultiple (X := X) P U hU f hf) =
      sectionOfRegularMultiple (X := X) P V hV f (fun x hx hxV => hf x hx (hVU hxV)) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [divisorSectionsRes_coe hVU hV]
  rfl

/-- A rational function gives a section of the produced canonical sheaf
exactly when its product with the selected differential is regular everywhere
on the open. -/
theorem mem_canonicalSheaf_iff_regularMultiple
    (U : X.left.Opens) (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty)
    (f : X.left.functionField) :
    f ∈ divisorSections P.divisor U ↔
      ∀ (x : X.left) (_hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left), x ∈ U →
        f • P.differential ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x :=
  section_mem_iff (X := X) P U hU f

end CanonicalDivisorSheafProducer

end
end Hartshorne
